commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Lamine Camara (Metz) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ibou Sane, but Radoslaw Majecki displays great awareness to stop him.
89' Substitution. Vanderson makes his way off the pitch and Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) comes on as his replacement.
87' 2 - 5 Goal! Folarin Balogun (Monaco) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top right corner. He makes it 2:5.
87' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
84' 2 - 4 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Ibou Sane (Metz) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
83' The corner from Lamine Camara (Metz) is cleared away by the defence.
82' Substitution. Abou Lo did his best and is replaced by Ibou Sane (Metz).
82' Laszlo Boloni has decided to substitute Georges Mikautadze and he is replaced by Sadibou Sane (Metz).
81' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Substitution. Edan Diop (Monaco) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Aleksandr Golovin walks off.
78' 1 - 4 Pape Diallo (Metz) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
78' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
76' 0 - 4 Goal! Alexandre Oukidja makes a huge mistake and Folarin Balogun (Monaco) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 0:4.
75' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
73' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
73' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
71' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ablie Jallow (Metz).
70' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
69' Vanderson (Monaco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
67' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
66' Substitution. Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) in, Youssouf Fofana out.
66' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Eliesse Ben Seghir is replaced by Folarin Balogun (Monaco).
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Takumi Minamino will be replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
64' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
64' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
60' Lamine Camara (Metz) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
60' Matthieu Udol (Metz) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
58' Arthur Atta (Metz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
56' Ismael Traore (Metz) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
55' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Koffi Kouao (Metz) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
54' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) sends a cross into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja comes off his line to gather the ball.
53' The ball is cleared after Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
52' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
52' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
51' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) plays a terrific long ball forward to Wissam Ben Yedder, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
51' The shot by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Alexandre Oukidja.
50' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' A pass by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
48' Great touch by Lamine Camara (Metz) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
47' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) makes a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Lamine Camara (Metz) passes the ball onto Georges Mikautadze, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
43' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) tries to find Wissam Ben Yedder, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
43' Vanderson (Monaco) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
42' The foul by Matthieu Udol (Metz) was seen by Eric Wattellier who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
41' Good defending. Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) tries to find Wissam Ben Yedder inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
39' A pass from Pape Diallo (Metz) is intercepted by Radoslaw Majecki and the move breaks down.
39' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
37' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
37' The referee blows his whistle as Koffi Kouao (Metz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
37' Arthur Atta (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
35' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) sees the run of Wilfried Singo and tries to slip the ball to him, but Alexandre Oukidja sees the danger and gathers.
35' A pass by Arthur Atta (Metz) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
34' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
33' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.
32' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
31' Fali Cande (Metz) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Radoslaw Majecki was alert and made a comfortable save.
29' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
29' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Youssouf Fofana.
25' Pape Diallo (Metz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
24' The substitution has been made. Pape Diallo (Metz) has replaced Joel Asoro.
23' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends a long cross over to Takumi Minamino, but Alexandre Oukidja comes forward to gather the ball.
20' Great teamplay by Monaco as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
16' 0 - 3 Goal! Aleksandr Golovin puts a cross into the box and finds Vanderson (Monaco), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:3.
13' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Radoslaw Majecki pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
13' Lamine Camara (Metz) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
10' 0 - 2 Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alexandre Oukidja with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 0:2.
8' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Metz.
6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.
4' 0 - 1 Takumi Minamino (Monaco) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball inside the left post.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Metz will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Eric Wattellier.
